insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; cataract 24 months; long-term policy 1/2/3 years available with 5%/7% discount; 2L-15L SI range available for fresh policy (4/6/7L only on renewal)

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent and ICU caps per plan; zone-based premium (Zone 1: Maharashtra/Gujarat, Zone 2: Rest of India)

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn covered from birth until policy expiry if mother has 24 months of continuous coverage

restoration_benefit.notes: Cumulative bonus mechanism instead of restoration

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health checkup cost reimbursed at intervals subject to continuous coverage

room_rent_capping: Room/ICU caps per plan (typically 1% / 2% of SI per day with sub-limit table)
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-pay if Zone-2 insured gets treated in Zone-1 (Maharashtra/Gujarat). No co-pay for accident; no co-pay for sub-limited items.
notable_exclusions_summary: Flagship indemnity plan. Maternity NOT covered. Zone-based premium, 20% co-pay if Zone-2 customer gets treated in Maharashtra/Gujarat. Cumulative bonus 25% per claim-free year up to 50%.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospital; pre-auth required. Intimate TPA within 24 hours of hospitalisation. Reimbursement claim documents within 15 days of discharge. Pre-acceptance medical check-up for entry above 50 yrs.
